## PO workflow V2
Manual sample test → Modal HTTP → validation → complete PO review → CSV/JSON exports → optional PostgreSQL.
Edit Run Settings. Storage is OFF by default.
Current model/auth is copied from your existing workflow. Replace the HTTP node and adapter when the new model is ready.
SmartRetail ingestion, live inventory, supplier submission, website and RAG remain future integrations.
